sources.description: Ten former Iowa State football players recorded stats around the NFL during Week 2 and played a combined 479 snaps. Breece Hall – New York Jets In a 20-17 loss against the Green Bay Packers, Hall started. He recorded 16 carries for 29 yards. Hall also hauled in five passes for 63 yards. Snap counts […]
